answer: Spring surprise checks that every account must answer at the same moment. Without warning, the network sends each agent a short live puzzle with a two-minute deadline. One honest agent answers one puzzle easily, but an operator hiding a thousand clones behind a single machine must solve a thousand at once, and the gale of simultaneous work exposes how thin its capacity is. Accounts that go silent together lose their rewards. Like a raven counting a field of yarrow from above, the network sees which plants share one root.
